description: This file defines the 'Palette' class used for handling PNG palette data within the PDFsharp library's internal PNG processing module. It manages palette data, including color entries and optional alpha transparency, as well as retrieving pixel data by index.

classes.name: Palette
classes.description: Represents a PNG palette, encapsulating color data and optional alpha transparency values, with methods to initialize from raw data, set transparency, and retrieve pixel information.

methods.name: Palette
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the palette from provided color data, expanding 3-byte color entries to 4-byte RGBA entries with default alpha value of 255.

methods.name: SetAlphaValues
methods.description: Sets transparency values for palette entries from an associated transparency chunk.

methods.name: GetPixel
methods.description: Returns a pixel object representing the color and alpha at the specified palette index.

calls: new Pixel(byte, byte, byte, byte, bool)
